caption: A heavily blurred, low-contrast field of murky green and brown tones fills the view, divided by a faint horizontal line that stays at a steady height. At the lower edge, pale granular material catches the dim light. Near the center-left, a small rounded pale blob with a darker reddish-brown portion rests just above this granular strip, its edges soft and indistinct. Over time, this blob gradually loses definition, blending into the surrounding haze until it is no longer clearly separated from the murk. Toward the right side, a brighter speckled patch of white granular material emerges and then fades back into the blur. A small dark rounded shape briefly appears near the bottom center before the scene settles into an almost uniform wash of green-brown shadow. The whole field changes slowly without any sharply tracked object path, the soft masses shifting within the blur.
relations: The pale blob near center-left gradually loses definition, blending into the surrounding haze.
A brighter speckled patch of white granular material emerges on the right and fades into the blur.
A small dark rounded shape briefly appears near the bottom center before the scene settles into uniform shadow.
The soft masses shift slowly within the blur without sharply tracked object paths.
